Mr. Achebe nods to him as the advisor busies himself with adding sugar cubes to his coffee. "I do admit our response was... a bit slow. We were having some exercises our southern islands (OOC I just forgot to respond in time T-T). But I do hope we can look past that, as we don't have much of a reason to be enemies. This is meant to be much more of a secure meeting, one that doesn't need too many eyes on it simply with the purpose of smoothing out relation's with our neighbors new administration."[/quote]

President Khan stares into Representative Minister Achebe's eyes for a moment before responding. "I have no interest in antagonising you or your country, but I don't trust you or your intentions towards us. If this answer satisfies your curiosity about my regard for you and your country then we can consider the meeting concluded unless you have another point to discuss with me."

After addressing the Lavian Representative Minister, he whispers to Minister Shari, "I saw his eyes shine, he is up to something."

(OOC: a little bit of background on the eyes shining part since its a piece of culture that's too obscure to just know. Some Iranic cultures consider shining eyes to be a sign of mischief.)

[b]|[/b]Opening Embassy between United Lavian Republic and Sovereign Union of Roskesak Republic|
[u]St. Valeskov  Aug 2, 2025[/u]

Intro Playing* (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JI5xkplVRGM&list=RDJI5xkplVRGM&start_radio=1)

[u][b]Polina Elmira (Fox)[/b][/u]
 Good morning to all citizens of the Sovereign Union of Roskesak Republic. Im Polina Elmira.

[u][b]Valkus Boris (Sheep)[/b][/u]
 And Im Valkus Boris. Today marks a moment of unity and diplomacy as the Embassy of the United Lavian Republic officially opens in our capital, St. Valeskov.

[u][b](Polina Elmira)[/b][/u]
The embassy represents a historic step in bridging relations between Humans and Furrys, promoting peace, recognition, and cooperation between our nations. And now, we take you live to our field reporters outside the newly opened embassy building.

[u][b](Reporter)[/b][/u]
 Its a bright and hopeful morning here in St. Valeskov, where the national flags of the United Lavian Republic and the S.U.R.R. now fly side by side. Dignitaries from both nations have entered the building. Crowds have gathered, and a festive energy surrounds the embassy's opening ceremony."

STATIC INTERRUPTION

A black SUV barrels through a security barrier, smashing into the press zone* Screams erupt* The camera shakes violently*

[u][b](Cameraman panicked)[/b][/u]
 Are you okay?! IS EVERYONE

Gunshot heard in background*

[u][b](Polina Elmira)[/b][/u]
We are receiving unconfirmed reports that the embassy opening ceremony has been attacked. A vehicle, believed to be weaponized, crashed into the perimeter during our live coverage. Witnesses at the scene report multiple explosions. Emergency responders, including local police and KGI rapid-response teams, are now en route to secure the area. Initial intelligence suggests the Jihad Cheza-Qauiz terrorist group has claimed responsibility for this act of aggression. Early reports indicate a hostage situation is unfolding inside the ULR embassy compound, involving embassy staff, foreign diplomats, and attending civilians. At this time, we do not have confirmation on the safety of our on-site reporters or crew. Our thoughts are with them and everyone caught in this devastating attack. For all citizens and bystanders: avoid the Valutevan Street district immediately. Leave roadways open for KGI and enforcement units. Do not approach the embassy zone under any circumstances. We urge the public to remain calm. Let our security forces do their job. We are cutting away now to allow secure communication.
Stay safe. Stay vigilant. We will update you as the situation develops.
[/i][nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation][/quote]
People watch from an airport terminal, grumbling about their fights being delayed as a low rumble gets louder and louder. A few lucky travelers near the windows manage to film two large military transport aircraft touch down on both runways, stopping right on the tarmac, opening their cargo doors, and deploy a small convoy of armored vehicles all within the timespan of 5 minutes. The convoy takes a small amount of time to ensure everything is right, and they speed off to an access gate as the aircraft close their doors and taxi to a parking zone. Meeting the convoy at the access gate, two police cars blair their sirens as they speed through the streets, making a beeline for the embassy. 

The second they arrive at the police perimeter around the embassy, the turrets atop the vehicles train on the embassy, watching for a sign of threat. The other men embark from their seats, either making for buildings to take up positions on roofs, setting up a large truck that can be assumed is a mobile command center, or discerning themselves with whatever they have been trained to do. One of the men, certainly older than most of the others, walks up to the highest ranking officer he can find. Shortly after, a man who looks to be in his 20s runs over to him and says something in Llyndorran that the officer cant recognize. After the two men have a quick exchange of words, the younger man points to a badge on his vest and says in accented Roskesan ISRP officers. We need to speak to whoever is in charge here.
